nom: Good Molecules Bakuchiol Oil Blend for Dry Skin

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report strong, fast hydration and reduced flaking, though a few say it did nothing for their dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with eczema, dermatitis, or retinol intolerance, mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating, though some report burning eyes, purging, or an allergic reaction with hives.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report hydration without increased oiliness and, in one case, clearer and less acne-prone skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the dry-skin formula still worked well, hydrating without adding excess oil.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-50s, menopausal) report smoother, firmer, more hydrated skin and softened fine lines with regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer notes the product may work better as a hydrator for normal or oily skin than for very dry skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, forehead lines, crow's feet, and the 'elevens' with weeks to months of use; one used it successfully to reduce stretch marks; a few see no aging benefit at all.
concerns.dehydration: The majority describe marked, often fast relief from dryness and flaking, with skin staying hydrated through the day or overnight; a minority report no change in dryness after weeks of use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes improved blood flow and texture; no other redness-specific outcomes are described.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the oil restored her skin barrier after benzoyl-peroxide treatment, and others with eczema or dermatitis-prone dry skin say patches of damaged skin healed within days.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of acne scars, dark marks, sun spots, and post-inflammatory pigmentation with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some acne-prone or combination-skin users, report fewer breakouts, faster healing of flare-ups, or milia clearing; a few report new breakouts, hormonal-acne flares, or an allergic hive reaction.
concerns.oiliness: One oily-skin reviewer reports the product reduced oil production; others note the oil itself can feel greasy or shiny for up to an hour before absorbing, especially with daytime use.

aspects.libelle: Mild earthy or clean scent, non-bothersome
Bottle size too small for price
Greasy or slow to absorb on application

extraits.titre: Not worth even the low price
extraits.texte: My local Ulta was out of the Ordinary Rose hip oil I usually get, so was recommended this. Was first shocked at the extremly tiny bottle. The first use was underwhelming, my skin felt like I had put nothing on at all. I have fairly dry skin, so if you have oily/normal skin this product may be hydrating. For me, after 2 weeks of using I am just tossing the bottle out. My skin has stayed dry since using it, I went a few days without it and there was no difference in dryness. So it is as good as using nothing at all.
I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This was too heavy for my skin, but every once in a while it helped with hydration.

extraits.titre: Visible improvement day 1 but is greasy
extraits.texte: My skin is too sensitive for retinol. This immediately made a significant improvement on my shallow pitted acne scars and fine lines, and a little goes a long way. I just dont like that its an oil, takes like 10mins to absorb enough to finish my routine, but is still greasy for at least an hour before bed, and made my face the bad kind of shiny all day when i tried it during the day. When i apply to fingers as instructed i used 6-8 drops; when i apply to face i use 1 drop per cheek and less than 1 drop for the rest. Cant beat the price!

For someone with extremely dry skin in the winter, sensitive skin & eczema on top of that it is so hard finding a product that actually stays on the skin and works!! This product has made my small patches of dryness literally go away. You cant beat the proce either. Will be trying other prodcuts from this brand.

I pray they never stop making this. Tried many oils but this has been the missing key product. I have very dry, flaky, sensitive skin. This took a week to make my skin look almost flawless. My acne is basically gone, flakes are gone, lines look smoother, skin looks brighter, fuller, and healthier. I use a facial mist, Good Molecules' Peptide Serum, a light moisturizer, and then a couple drops of this. I'm 33 but my skin can't handle retinol and I've been kind of amazed at how much better my forehead lines look after a few weeks. I wear it night and day and it doesn't affect my makeup, if that tells you how dry my skin is. The price is phenomenal as well.

I was skeptical about using a facial oil as someone with combination, acne prone skin, but this product works wonders. I've replaced my harsh retinol product with a few drops of this oil in a lightweight moisturizer, and my skin has never been clearer or bouncier. If I've had a recent acne flare up, I'll use it overnight straight onto my skin, and in the morning my skin is moisturized and glowing, with significant healing of any problem areas. I have tried every moisturizer and every acne product you can imagine. I am actually angry that I spent years struggling with my skin without this. I'm not exaggerating when I say it's a miracle product for me.

Amazing i will never stop buying this. After acne treatment with benzoyl peroxide, this oil along with squalene oil has restored my skin barrier to be healthy and moist even though i have a dry skin type!
